name: wordcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for WordCraft: write documents (headings, lists, tables, images, table of contents, headers and footers), edit them with find/replace, comments and tracked changes, mail-merge from CSV or spreadsheets, convert between docx, pdf, odt, rtf, html, md and tex, and preview pages with WordCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . wordcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Write, edit, mail-merge and convert documents with your local WordCraft
defaultPrompt: Write a two-page report with a table of contents as DOCX and PDF
Replace the client name in these contracts and track the changes
Merge this CSV into personalized letters
